"""Intent tests for compare.run_claims (M1-T19): TC-21 to TC-24 and the report."""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.compare import Claim, ClaimSpec, run_claims
from rllab.evaluate import ScoreSet

FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "fixtures" / "rllab"


def _load(case: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    folder = FIXTURES / case
    inputs = json.loads((folder / "input.json").read_text())
    expected = json.loads((folder / "expected.json").read_text())
    return inputs, expected


def _spec(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> ClaimSpec:
    return ClaimSpec(
        name=raw["name"],
        a=raw["a"],
        b=raw["b"],
        direction=raw["direction"],
        stretch=raw.get("stretch", False),
        min_ratio=raw.get("min_ratio"),
    )


def _poisson_scores(
    players: dict[str, float], seeds: int, games: int, seed: int
) -> dict[str, tuple[ScoreSet, ...]]:
    """Generator `poisson_scores`: per player, `seeds` ScoreSets of `games` Poisson draws."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    out: dict[str, tuple[ScoreSet, ...]] = {}
    for name, lam in players.items():
        out[name] = tuple(
            ScoreSet(
                player=name,
                train_seed=train_seed,
                scores=rng.poisson(lam, games).astype(np.float64),
                games=(),
            )
            for train_seed in range(seeds)
        )
    return out


def _fixed_scores(name: str, values: list[float], seeds: int = 5) -> tuple[ScoreSet, ...]:
    """Split a fixed score list evenly over training seeds (pooling restores the list)."""
    chunks = np.array_split(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64), seeds)
    return tuple(
        ScoreSet(player=name, train_seed=i, scores=chunk, games=())
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)
    )


def _seed_range(text: str) -> range:
    lo, hi = (int(part) for part in text.split("-"))
    return range(lo, hi + 1)


def _only(claims: list[Claim]) -> Claim:
    assert len(claims) == 1
    return claims[0]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc21_planted_gap_is_detected(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, expected = _load("TC-21")
    scores = _poisson_scores(
        inputs["players"], inputs["seeds"], inputs["games_per_seed"], inputs["seed"]
    )
    spec = _spec(inputs["claim"])
    claim = _only(run_claims(scores, [spec], alpha=expected["alpha"], out=tmp_path))
    assert claim.spec == spec
    assert claim.passed is expected["passed"]
    assert claim.p_corrected <= expected["alpha"]
    assert claim.mean_a > claim.mean_b
    assert isinstance(claim.method, str)
    assert claim.method.strip() != ""


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc21_means_are_pooled_over_seeds(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, expected = _load("TC-21")
    scores = _poisson_scores(
        inputs["players"], inputs["seeds"], inputs["games_per_seed"], inputs["seed"]
    )
    spec = _spec(inputs["claim"])
    claim = _only(run_claims(scores, [spec], alpha=expected["alpha"], out=tmp_path))
    pooled_a = np.concatenate([s.scores for s in scores[spec.a]])
    pooled_b = np.concatenate([s.scores for s in scores[spec.b]])
    assert claim.mean_a == pytest.approx(float(pooled_a.mean()), rel=1e-9)
    assert claim.mean_b == pytest.approx(float(pooled_b.mean()), rel=1e-9)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc22_pure_noise_is_rarely_significant(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, expected = _load("TC-22")
    spec = _spec(inputs["claim"])
    passed = 0
    for gen_seed in _seed_range(inputs["generator_seeds"]):
        scores = _poisson_scores(
            inputs["players"], inputs["seeds"], inputs["games_per_seed"], gen_seed
        )
        out = tmp_path / str(gen_seed)
        out.mkdir()
        claim = _only(run_claims(scores, [spec], alpha=expected["alpha"], out=out))
        assert claim.method.strip() != ""
        passed += int(claim.passed)
    assert passed <= expected["max_passed"]


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["a", "b"])
def test_tc23_not_worse_both_ways(case: str, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, expected = _load("TC-23")
    scores = _poisson_scores(
        inputs["cases"][case]["players"],
        inputs["seeds"],
        inputs["games_per_seed"],
        inputs["seed"],
    )
    spec = _spec(inputs["claim"])
    claim = _only(run_claims(scores, [spec], alpha=expected["alpha"], out=tmp_path))
    assert claim.passed is expected[case]["passed"]
    assert claim.method.strip() != ""


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["pass", "fail"])
def test_tc24_ratio_bar_is_inclusive(case: str, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, expected = _load("TC-24")
    raw = inputs["cases"][case]
    scores = {
        "a": _fixed_scores("a", raw["a"]),
        "b": _fixed_scores("b", raw["b"]),
    }
    spec = _spec(inputs["claim"])
    assert spec.min_ratio == expected["min_ratio"]
    claim = _only(run_claims(scores, [spec], out=tmp_path))
    tol = expected["tol"]
    assert claim.mean_a == pytest.approx(expected[case]["mean_a"], abs=tol)
    assert claim.mean_b == pytest.approx(expected[case]["mean_b"], abs=tol)
    assert claim.passed is expected[case]["passed"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_one_correction_covers_every_claim(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, _ = _load("TC-21")
    players = {"a": 10.0, "b": 8.0, "c": 10.0}
    scores = _poisson_scores(players, inputs["seeds"], inputs["games_per_seed"], inputs["seed"])
    specs = [
        ClaimSpec(name="a greater than b", a="a", b="b", direction="greater"),
        ClaimSpec(name="a greater than c", a="a", b="c", direction="greater"),
        ClaimSpec(name="c not worse than a", a="c", b="a", direction="not_worse"),
    ]
    claims = run_claims(scores, specs, out=tmp_path)
    assert [c.spec for c in claims] == specs
    for claim in claims:
        assert 0.0 <= claim.p_value <= 1.0
        assert claim.p_value <= claim.p_corrected <= 1.0
        assert claim.method.strip() != ""
    # With three claims corrected together, at least one corrected p-value grows.
    assert any(c.p_corrected > c.p_value for c in claims if c.p_value < 1.0 / len(specs))


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_missing_player_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    scores = {"a": _fixed_scores("a", [1.0] * 10)}
    spec = ClaimSpec(name="a greater than ghost", a="a", b="ghost", direction="greater")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ghost"):
        run_claims(scores, [spec], out=tmp_path)


def _numbers(line: str) -> list[float]:
    return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", line)]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_report_lists_player_means_and_labels_stretch(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs, _ = _load("TC-24")
    raw = inputs["cases"]["pass"]
    scores = {
        "alpha-player": _fixed_scores("alpha-player", raw["a"]),
        "beta-player": _fixed_scores("beta-player", raw["b"]),
    }
    means = {
        "alpha-player": float(np.mean(raw["a"])),
        "beta-player": float(np.mean(raw["b"])),
    }
    regular = ClaimSpec(
        name="alpha-player not worse than beta-player",
        a="alpha-player",
        b="beta-player",
        direction="not_worse",
    )
    stretch = ClaimSpec(
        name="alpha-player beats beta-player",
        a="alpha-player",
        b="beta-player",
        direction="greater",
        stretch=True,
    )
    run_claims(scores, [regular, stretch], out=tmp_path)
    report = tmp_path / "report.md"
    assert report.is_file()
    lines = report.read_text().splitlines()

    for player, mean in means.items():
        player_lines = [line for line in lines if player in line and len(_numbers(line)) >= 2]
        assert player_lines, f"no line with {player}'s mean and spread"
        assert any(
            any(abs(n - mean) <= 0.01 for n in _numbers(line)) for line in player_lines
        ), f"{player}'s mean {mean} not reported"

    stretch_lines = [line for line in lines if stretch.name in line]
    assert stretch_lines
    assert any("stretch" in line.lower() for line in stretch_lines)
    regular_lines = [line for line in lines if regular.name in line]
    assert regular_lines
    assert all("stretch" not in line.lower() for line in regular_lines)

def _fixed_scores(name: str, values: list[float], seeds: int = 5) -> tuple[ScoreSet, ...]:
    """Split a fixed score list evenly over training seeds (pooling restores the list)."""
    chunks = np.array_split(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64), seeds)
    return tuple(
        ScoreSet(player=name, train_seed=i, scores=chunk, games=())
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks)
    )


def _seed_range(text: str) -> range:
    lo, hi = (int(part) for part in text.split("-"))
    return range(lo, hi + 1)
